Task Guide: Task: Task: Train XGBoost model
Description: Generate a comprehensive dataset of sulphides polymorphs from Materials Project and train an XGBoost model to predict formation energies. path to the results file (eg. model_evaluation_results.json)

- learning_rate: 0.1
- subsample: 0.8
- colsample_bytree: 0.8
- reg_alpha: 0.1
- reg_lambda: 0.1
- detailed_analysis: True
- cv_folds: 5
